footer.aboutTitle: About This Harvard Entrance Exam Quiz
footer.aboutText: This is a fun Harvard-style reasoning quiz built around quick logic, number patterns, word clues, probability, and everyday brain teasers. It is for entertainment and self-challenge only. It is not an official Harvard University exam, admissions test, IQ test, academic assessment, or educational credential.

stageGroups.title: Warm-Up Logic
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. The next round adds a little more pressure with probability, analogies, and sharper patterns.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
questions.explanation: The sequence doubles each time, so 24 becomes 48.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Orange?
questions.explanation: Carrot is a vegetable; the others are fruits.

questions.prompt: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be in 10 days?
questions.explanation: Ten days after Tuesday lands on Friday.

questions.prompt: If all Bloops are Razzies, and all Razzies are Lazzies, what must be true?
questions.explanation: If Bloops are Razzies and Razzies are Lazzies, then Bloops must also be Lazzies.

questions.prompt: Which shape has the fewest sides: square, pentagon, hexagon, triangle?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides, fewer than the others listed.

questions.prompt: If CAT becomes DBU, what does DOG become?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by one: D becomes E, O becomes P, and G becomes H.

questions.prompt: Which number is even: 13, 19, 22, 27?
questions.explanation: 22 is divisible by 2, so it is even.

questions.prompt: Three friends each shake hands with every other friend once. How many handshakes occur?
questions.explanation: The handshakes are A-B, A-C, and B-C: 3 total.

questions.prompt: Which letter comes next: B, D, F, H, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern skips one letter each time, so H is followed by J.

questions.prompt: If a train leaves at 1:20 and arrives at 2:05, how long was the trip?
questions.explanation: From 1:20 to 2:05 is 45 minutes.

stageGroups.title: Brain Teasers
stageGroups.encouragement: Good. The final admissions round turns up the challenge with probability, cubes, vocabulary, and careful logic.

questions.prompt: Which number is missing: 2, 5, 10, 17, ?
questions.explanation: The differences are 3, 5, and 7, so the next difference is 9. 17 plus 9 is 26.

questions.prompt: Ana is taller than Ben. Ben is taller than Cara. Who is tallest?
questions.explanation: Ana is taller than Ben, and Ben is taller than Cara, so Ana is tallest.

questions.prompt: Which pair matches pen : write?
questions.explanation: A pen is used to write, and a brush is used to paint.

questions.prompt: If MIND becomes NJOE, what does TEST become?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by one, so TEST becomes UFTU.

questions.prompt: A basket contains 5 red balls and 3 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
questions.explanation: There are 8 balls total, and 5 are red, so the probability is 5/8.

questions.prompt: A farmer has 20 cows. Half are brown. How many are brown?
questions.explanation: Half of 20 is 10.

questions.prompt: Which word best completes: doctor : hospital :: teacher : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor is associated with a hospital, and a teacher is associated with a school.

questions.prompt: Two notebooks cost £8. How much do five notebooks cost?
questions.explanation: Each notebook costs £4, so five notebooks cost £20.

questions.prompt: Which number completes: 1, 8, 27, 64, ?
questions.explanation: The numbers are cubes: 1, 2 cubed, 3 cubed, 4 cubed, then 5 cubed is 125.

questions.prompt: A meeting starts at 10:15 and ends at 11:05. How long does it last?
questions.explanation: From 10:15 to 11:05 is 50 minutes.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is the sum of the two before it, so 5 plus 8 is 13.

questions.prompt: A clock shows 3:00. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.explanation: At 3:00, the hands form a right angle, which is 90°.

questions.prompt: If some artists are writers, and all writers are readers, what must be true?
questions.explanation: The artists who are writers must also be readers.

questions.prompt: Which is larger: one-half or two-fifths?
questions.explanation: One-half is 0.5, while two-fifths is 0.4.

questions.prompt: If two people can paint two walls in two hours, how many walls can four people paint in two hours?
questions.explanation: Doubling the number of people doubles the work done in the same time, so they paint 4 walls.

questions.prompt: You flip a fair coin three times. What is the probability of getting heads all three times?
questions.explanation: Each flip has a 1/2 chance of heads, so 1/2 × 1/2 × 1/2 equals 1/8.

questions.prompt: A cube is painted on all sides and cut into 27 equal cubes. How many small cubes have paint on exactly two faces?
questions.explanation: In a 3 by 3 by 3 cube, the edge-center cubes have paint on exactly two faces. There are 12 of them.
This is ordinary addition: 42 plus 13 equals 55.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to meticulous?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means very careful and precise.

questions.prompt: Three consecutive numbers add up to 72. What is the middle number?
questions.explanation: For three consecutive numbers, the middle number is the average. 72 divided by 3 is 24.
